about: The Hearth: Milo's camp as a fortress that grows into a kingdom (WORLD.md §2). Hearthvale itself is always sanctuary: no rift ever opens inside it. Each tier pushes the Hearthward (wardRadius, in tiles beyond Hearthvale's edge) further into the wilds. Tiers need real progress (requirements, which can't be grinded), game materials and Construction. Every defence is a real MILO capability, usually an automation, so a stronger kingdom means fewer problems ever reach the walls.

tiers.name: The Camp
tiers.look: A tent, a log cabin, a campfire with three stumps and a bench, and the iron Lantern Hook.

defences.name: The Lantern Hook
defences.real: Hearthvale is sanctuary: rifts open only in the wilds beyond it, and the closer one opens to the vale, the more urgent it is.

defences.name: The Watchtower
defences.real: Watchkeeping: every crew session, live.

tiers.name: The Stockade
tiers.look: A timber palisade round the vale, a gate with a bell, and banners on the watchtower.

defences.name: The War Table
defences.real: Every open rift on one map with its real cause: the problems dashboard.

defences.name: The Gate Bell
defences.real: Rifts that reach the walls ring a soft bell (a desktop note), once.

defences.name: The first ward-post
defences.real: An auto-ward rule: quests you've marked 'someday' never open rifts until you ask.

unlocks: Room for a second row of plots

tiers.name: The Hold
tiers.look: Stone walls, a gatehouse with a portcullis, a barracks, and two squat ward-towers.

defences.name: Ward-towers
defences.real: Two auto-ward rules of your choosing, such as: hold Nocturne rifts on a Stillday, or snooze admin rifts until Monday.

defences.name: The Sally Port
defences.real: Send the crew out from the gate: a queue for commissions, so they never pile up.

defences.name: The Barracks
defences.real: Residents who stay live here, each with their real service.

tiers.name: The Keep
tiers.look: A stone keep with Milo's lantern at the top of its tower, a bell tower, and a market square.

defences.name: The Dawn Bell tower
defences.real: The morning brief, rung from the keep.

defences.name: Ballistae
defences.real: Auto-dispatch rules: when a rift of a kind you choose opens (a failing check, say), a crew member sets out to fix it under a ward, and asks before changing anything important.

defences.name: Lookouts
defences.real: Rifts are seen on the horizon earlier: deadlines 7 days out instead of 2.

unlocks: A branch of the Tide Market

tiers.name: The Castle
tiers.look: Curtain walls with towers, a moat and drawbridge, guild halls, and a great hall with banners.

requirements.text: Six residents living in the Hold

defences.name: Guild halls
defences.real: Each faction's hall runs its domain's rules (the Quiet Order holds your evening bell; the Tide Syndics watch deadlines).

defences.name: The Hangar
defences.real: Titan defence: big deadlines get a countdown and a plan the moment they're seen.

defences.name: The Great Hall
defences.real: Starfall, the weekly review, held as a feast.

tiers.name: The Citadel
tiers.look: Tiers of white stone climbing a hill, districts for every craft, an observatory dome.

defences.name: The Observatory
defences.real: Long sight: 14-day horizon for deadlines and Titans, and a monthly look ahead.

defences.name: Siege engines
defences.real: Bigger auto-dispatch: chains of crew runs (research, build, test) for rifts you choose.

defences.name: Districts
defences.real: A district per life skill, each showing that area's quests, buildings and rifts together.

tiers.name: The Kingdom
tiers.look: A walled city under the Lantern Spire, banners on every tower, roads out to every outpost.

defences.name: The Lantern Spire
defences.real: The Hearthward reaches every outpost: your whole working world, watched.

defences.name: Royal decrees
defences.real: Standing rules for everything (focus, rest, crew, alerts) set as decrees and shown in one place.

defences.name: The coronation
defences.real: A title, a banner and a year-in-review written into the Chronicle.

unlocks: A kingdom banner of your design

tiers.name: The Bright Kingdom
tiers.look: The Spire burns white; every befriended Elsewhere opens as a door around the city walls.

requirements.text: Meet the Beginner at the Margin (Act VII)

defences.name: The Bookmark
defences.real: Every befriended Elsewhere becomes a door you can open from the walls, whenever you like.

defences.name: The Kingdom's light
defences.real: Your year, your buildings and your residents, shown on the far shelf beside other books.

unlocks: The kingdom's light on the far shelf
